svg.text: Place the LQFP package in the central footprint; the six SPI
contacts are at the bottom of the adapter body.
SPI: /CS, MISO, GND, VCC, CLK, MOSI
* The interface labels are /CS, MISO, GND, VCC, CLK, and MOSI.
* The six labeled SPI contacts (/CS, MISO, GND, VCC, CLK, MOSI) are at the bottom of the long adapter/ZIF body.
* The six labeled SPI signals use an eight-contact interface; two positions are unlabeled.
* The adapter body is marked PIN1.
Note: The full package-to-interface pin mapping is unspecified.
